Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: The Effects of Reading Habits and Methods to Encourage Reading
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"With the overwhelming rise of short-form digital media, fewer people maintain the habit of reading books. Many educators stress that reading books exercises the brain, expands vocabulary, and deepens emotional empathy."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive effects of cultivating a regular reading habit and proposing feasible measures that schools and families can implement to encourage people, especially the youth, to read more. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.
title: Task 2.1: The Effects of Reading Habits and Methods to Encourage Reading
content:
Read the following statement:

"With the overwhelming rise of short-form digital media, fewer people maintain the habit of reading books. Many educators stress that reading books exercises the brain, expands vocabulary, and deepens emotional empathy."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the positive effects of cultivating a regular reading habit and proposing feasible measures that schools and families can implement to encourage people, especially the youth, to read more. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was spending hours watching short videos every night and struggled to focus in class. Therefore, he decided to read a printed history book for 30 minutes before bed each evening. As a result, he finally felt calmer and improved his grades in school writing tasks. If he had not built a daily reading habit, he would not have been able to concentrate so well.
body1.focus: Positive effects of cultivating a regular reading habit
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, cultivating a regular reading habit leads to several positive effects | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key impacts of cultivating a regular reading habit.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that reading books regularly allows people's brains to exercise and broadens their mind with new vocabulary and ideas. This means that young readers improve their focus, write better essays, and understand other people's feelings more deeply. Another point I would like to make is that diving into the world of a book helps people relieve stress and reduce fatigue. This is because of the fact that reading printed books in a quiet space protects our eyes from phone screens and brings inner peace.

body2.example: For example, many parents now keep a small bookshelf in the living room and read with their children before bedtime, while schools host monthly book-sharing days where students trade favorite novels. With steady effort from both sides, young people can build a lifelong reading habit step by step.
body2.focus: Practical measures from schools and families to encourage reading
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals and parents should limit daily screen time and set aside 20 minutes every evening to read together at home. In addition, schools and families need to upgrade libraries with interesting storybooks, organize fun reading clubs, and offer clear guidance on choosing good books. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, cultivating a regular reading habit is closely linked to exercising the brain and broadening knowledge and requires practical steps such as daily family reading routines and better school libraries. Therefore, both schools and families need to take steady, practical actions to reduce the decline in reading in the long run.
